NAM.note: Finance ministry speech; no central bank role stated.
Only a call to embed consumer protection and a strategy mention; no rules, body or enforcement stated.

facts.fact: Namibia's Ministry of Finance told the Fraud & Cybersecurity Summit that government-to-person payments processed through the Instant Payment System rose from about 1 million in July 2026 to 10 million in August, 25 million in September and 26 million in October (unit not stated).

NAM.note: A financial inclusion rate of about 86% is given with no survey named as an account-holding share.
IPS is said only to have potential for merchant and P2P payments; no wallet or interoperability service stated.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
